page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred lines with a printer's device (woodcut) in the middle; stamps at right are not text. No margin notes.
page.l: Antehac non nisi semel, nimirum Londini in aedibus Ioannis Day Anno M. D. LXXII. excusa:
NVNC vero boni publici ergô recognita & recusa.
Typis Wechelianis,apud Claud. Marnium & hæredes Ioannis Aubrii.
page.notes: Woodcut device of a winged horse above a shield-like emblem with hands and foliage, not transcribed. Red and blue library stamps at right, not transcribed. The first line reads in an italic script with a flourish; the spelling "Antehac" and "Londini" are as printed. The word "Antehac" and "Anno" are preceded by a decorative mark (manicule-like ornament) in the printed original.
